We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries. About The Role We are orchestrating the best high-performing team! As a Customer Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of a merchant's journey with Yuno from the first discovery call to the first transaction in production. You sit on both sides of the deal: you design the solution that wins it, and you build the integration that makes it real. Demos, technical discovery, architecture proposals, RFPs and security reviews on one side; integration planning, API guidance, testing, and go-live on the other. You will work with merchants processing millions of transactions across LATAM, each with a different stack, a different set of PSPs, and a different definition of "done". You will map their payment flows, find where Yuno fits, and translate that into something an engineering team can actually ship. Quality is the standard here, not the goal: every payment, every user, every time. An integration that goes live with unresolved edge cases is not a finished integration. No two merchants integrate the same way, and priorities shift as deals move. You will need to adapt fast, pick up new payment methods and markets as they come, and stay effective when the plan changes mid-cycle. You will also be the connection point between Sales, Product, Engineering, and the merchant's own developers, making sure nothing gets lost between what was promised and what was built. If you like being the person in the room who can answer the hard technical question and then go implement the answer, we want to talk to you. Your Contribution Will Be Lead technical discovery with prospects to understand their payment stack, requirements, and constraints. Run product demos and deliver technical presentations to engineering and product audiences. Design payment orchestration solutions and integration architectures tailored to each merchant. Respond to RFPs, security questionnaires, and technical due diligence with Sales. Own the end-to-end implementation, from kickoff and integration plan to testing and go-live. Guide merchant developers through Yuno's APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and payment method configurations. Troubleshoot integration issues across payment flows, API logs, and third-party providers. Build reusable demo environments, integration guides, and technical documentation that shorten future cycles. Hand off live merchants to Technical Account Management with complete context and documentation. Feed recurring merchant requirements and integration friction back to Product and Engineering. Skills You Need Minimum Qualifications Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required. Spanish or Portuguese is a plus. +4 years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical implementation, or integration roles. Hands-on technical skills: REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, HTTP debugging, and at least one programming language for building demos and sample integrations. Payments knowledge: gateways, PSPs, acquirers, card networks, 3DS, tokenization, refunds, chargebacks, and alternative payment methods. Experience running technical conversations with both engineering teams and commercial stakeholders. Proven track record delivering integration projects with external development teams on defined timelines. Comfortable working with SQL and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or similar. Ability to manage multiple merchants and deals in parallel without losing technical depth on any of them. Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities and processes evolve quickly. What We Offer at Yuno Competitive Compensation Remote Work – You can work from everywhere! Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office. Work Equipment Stock Options Health Plan wherever you are. Flexible Days Off We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or wish to exercise your data protection rights, please contact us at hiring@y.uno.

Serve as the site-level owner of data integrity for all facility-related information. Lead continuous improvement efforts to enhance operational effectiveness and facility performance. Ensure alignment with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards. Stakeholder & Resource Management Represent RDC and Kyndryl with service partners, suppliers, customers, and external communities. Leverage site resources effectively, including: People Technology Communication channels Partner with key stakeholders to ensure successful facility operations and project delivery. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards. Develop project plans, schedules, budgets, and risk mitigation strategies. Monitor project performance and communicate progress to stakeholders. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with internal and external stakeholders, including: Territory Leadership Site Leadership Marketing Security Corporate Health & Safety Chief Information Office (CIO) Human Resources Real Estate & Facilities Teams External Service Providers and Contractors Strategic Execution Translate business objectives into successful facility and infrastructure projects. Support workplace and operational transformation initiatives. Drive innovation and operational excellence across assigned sites. Ensure facilities reflect Kyndryl's commitment to quality, sustainability, safety, and employee experience. They excel in managing complex facility environments, optimizing costs, driving continuous improvement, leading transformational projects, and collaborating effectively across diverse teams to deliver outstanding business outcomes for Kyndryl. Who You Are What You'll Bring You are an experienced facilities and data center professional with a proven track record of managing complex operations, delivering strategic projects, and driving continuous improvement. Beyond your technical expertise, you demonstrate a growth mindset and are committed to ongoing professional development. You are customer-focused, ensuring operational decisions support business objectives and stakeholder satisfaction. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and coordinating diverse teams to achieve business objectives. Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, ensuring business requirements are clearly understood and achieved. Provide project governance, oversight, and reporting to ensure compliance with corporate standards, budgets, timelines, and quality requirements. Drive project performance through effective risk management, issue resolution, and continuous monitoring. Ensure all projects are completed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with strategic business goals. Team Development & Collaboration Support regional and global initiatives that promote collaboration, engagement, and knowledge sharing. Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning. Conduct project close-out reviews, capturing lessons learned and opportunities for future improvement. Act as a mentor and trusted advisor to colleagues and project teams. Financial Management & Risk Oversight Support annual operating and capital budget planning processes. Identify and implement cost optimization opportunities while maintaining operational excellence and service quality. Monitor financial performance and ensure projects remain within approved budgets. Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards, regulatory requirements, and audit controls. Proactively identify operational and project risks and develop effective mitigation strategies. Support business continuity, resilience, and risk management initiatives across the site portfolio. Multitasking & Prioritization: Ability to successfully manage multiple concurrent projects and operational priorities in a fast-paced environment. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels. Analytical Thinking: Strong capabilities in forecasting, investment planning, budgeting, reporting, audit readiness, and data-driven decision-making. Leadership & Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead diverse regional teams and influence stakeholders within complex matrix organizations. Organization & Problem Solving: Exceptional organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills with a proactive approach to resolving challenges. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred!
